title: ADR-012: Hold code to a repository-owned, machine-checkable architecture model
summary: Proposes a repository-committed architecture model (.avarice/architecture.json) with components, typed edges and shared resources, checked against the code graph at G4 and G2.
notes: Status is 'Proposed' (not Accepted), so locked is false despite ADR classification. Manifest declared type ADR and precedence 2; content matches ADR structure (Context/Decision/Consequences/Alternatives). Output filename omits the source_path hash because no hashing tool was available to the classifier.
